dedupe_keys.name: 岸和田市の下水道普及率 sewerage and wastewater

description: 岸和田市の下水道普及率 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 岸和田市. 平成7年度以降の岸和田市の下水道普及率、水洗化率およびＢＯＤ（生物化学的酸素要求量）のデータを掲載しています。 ＢＯＤとは生物化学的酸素要求量といい、一般的な水質指標の1つで、数値が大きいほど水質が悪いことを示しています。. Coverage: 岸和田市. The portal files it under the publisher 岸和田市. Its tags are 交通とインフラ. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
